_note: Tunables of rating.py (the fight rating: the bot's numbers against the monster's, by the engine's pre-AOS rules). A change here is read by every brain within its next rating, no restart. Owner, 2026-11-04: 'if the rating is determined to be too tight or loose or specific inputs, that can be adjusted'.
_engage_max_cost: the predicted hit points lost / hit points now (plus Heal potions drinkable in the fight), at or under which a bot takes the fight. Lower: more careful.
_max_ttk_s: a fight with one monster longer than this is not started (a pack: this x its size)
_scale: multipliers on each input: bot_dps on the bot's damage a second, monster_melee and monster_spells on what it takes from blows and spells, poison on the poison ticks, armor on the bot's armour rating
_potions: Heal potions the bot carries count as hit points, one per every_s seconds of the fight at heal_avg each (HealPotion 6-20 pre-AOS, a 10 s shared delay)
_kinds: per creature kind, e.g. {"shade": {"lost": 1.5}}: a multiplier on the predicted hit points lost, for a kind the model rates too kindly or too harshly. 2026-11-06/07, rating_check.py --hours 72: gazer 7 fights, 5 deaths, 80 lost against 21 predicted (3.73); gargoyle 3 fights, 3 deaths, 81 against 55 (1.47, a floor: every fight ended in a death). The rangers died 7 times to them in 13 hours, tracking leading them 68 tiles to a gazer rated 0.19
_bot_dps: 2026-11-08, rating_check.py --hours 48 over the nine melee dungeon fighters: real kill times run 2.2x the model's for every kind that stands and fights (lizardman 20.7 s against 9.4 over 2,093 fights, ratman 22.1 against 9.6 over 586, skeleton 11.5/5.0, zombie 8.4/4.0, bears and wolves 0.39-0.42), so the bot's damage a second is 0.43-0.48 of the model's: 0.45. A pack's loss piles up over those kill times, and four bots died to packs the old scale rated 0.07-0.49 (ettins and earth elementals in Despise, a mixed slime/snake/lizardman pack south of Britain); the ettin pack of eight now rates 0.94 (no fight)
_caster_dps: 2026-11-08: the casters' own kills against kinds that stand and fight, 30 days of fight records: zombie 11.1 s (158 kills) against the model's 8.2, skeleton 14.1 s (122) against 10.4 (cast delay 0.5 + 0.25 x circle, MagerySpell pre-AOS), both 1.35x, so a spell kill runs at 0.74 of the model; the melee scale (bot_dps 0.45, misses and chases) priced casters about twice too slow
_kite_leak: the share of a kited monster's blows that still land (a wall, a corner, a missed step), rating.kite_factor. 2026-11-08 23:10, work/botfarm-watch/kite_leak.py over the casters' first 38 kite_fight events (surface, single monsters): 197 hit points taken against 13,055 the stand-still rating predicts (0.02; attack-on-sight kinds alone 91 against 8,547, 0.011; no death); 0.05 = that rounded up for the walls and packs of a dungeon, to be measured again from dungeon kite fights
_kite_leak_by_step: the kite leak by the chaser's step (npc-speeds.json activeMove: Slow 0.6, Medium 0.45), 2026-11-09 04:35 from the casters' 269 kite_fight events (night of 2026-11-08, surface and Despise): Slow kinds 122 hit points taken against 8,339 standing (0.015, 59 fights, no death), Medium kinds 961 against 15,080 (0.064, 210 fights, 3 deaths, all in Despise's lizardman packs). kite_leak stays for a step not measured | 2026-11-10 01:05 over 10 hours (1,082 fights): Slow 0.398 (245 fights), Medium 0.378 (837)
_kite_leak_by_kind: the kite leak per creature kind (scale.kite_leak_by_kind), where the casters have 10 or more kite_fight events with it: 2026-11-10 01:05, work/botfarm-watch/kite_leak.py --hours 10 over the casters' 1,082 fights since the stair hold (gate 187), damage taken against the standing rating; capped at 1.0 (a kite costs no more than standing; over 1 the standing model under-rates the kind). Casters stand and cast more than the kite model assumes (first-circle casts beside an attacker, the stair hold's bouts): all kinds together 0.38 against the night of 11-08's 0.064/0.015; BotSorcAR rated a pack of five (ogre, ettin, shade, mongbats) 'lose ~40 of 93' and lost all 92 in 25 s (2026-11-10 00:56). kite_leak_by_step for the rest
